title: One adventure. Three ways to bring it together.
question: Choose a layout for Outdoor OS + TrailPack. These are visual mockups; example trip details are illustrative. You can also describe a combination or revision.

options.label: A · Trailhead workspace
options.thesis: Discovery and your next trip sit side by side, with one clear next step.
options.viewport: A wide trail discovery image beside a trip and packing panel; a shared navigation above and route suggestions below.
options.risk: A little less room for the map; it opens as a dedicated workspace.

options.label: B · Map-led workspace
options.thesis: Choose the route visually and keep the trip plan within reach.
options.viewport: A generous map with a compact trail browser and an attached trip planner.
options.risk: Denser on a phone; the map and planning panel need separate tabs.

options.label: C · Trip planner
options.thesis: The upcoming trip is the home screen, with preparation as the main task.
options.viewport: A dark green navigation rail and a broad trip workspace with route, dates, checklist, and recording action.
options.risk: Excellent for an existing plan; discovery takes one extra step.
